author: DaRealCritic
quote: Only women developers would think that turning GTA into a partnership, relationship Sim where you can only be loyal to 1 girl is a good idea. If you were gonna add the relationship bs. Should have made it for multiple women NPCs. That's my personal preference of course but I'm sure others agree. Only women developers would make a woman more masculine than her male counterpart and have her take charge while her partner blindly follows and gets caught in whatever mess she creates. That's basically the story in a nutshell up until the end where Jason pays for Lucia's ignorance in one way or another. Besides that, the story is dull and boring as a whole. There's a few interesting side missions if you stay awake long enough but this game is not a 10 out of 10. Since when is a buggy, 30fps game a 10? Since when do we ignore flaws just to build blind hype? The story is far from good, the characters far from interesting and yet this game got a 10 from over 100 critics? Get outta here

author: DaRealCritic
quote: The perfect remake did not exist until this masterpiece was made. It's just as I remember with a few changes of course but none of them bad. The music and Japanese voices really hit home. Sweet Nostalgia
